description: This file defines the AuthProvider class which manages authentication state in a Flutter application. It handles login, logout, session loading, token persistence, and integrates with real-time services. It uses external API and real-time service classes, and manages user data and authentication tokens.

classes.description: A provider class that manages user authentication state, token persistence, user data, and real-time connection management in a Flutter app.
